verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official MCP server (Agentic Toolbox MCP) explicitly for connecting Qodo's code-understanding, review, and rules skills to remote or custom agents, confirmed by both docs and a probe hit at the documented URL. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of MCP usage, detailed setup/auth documentation, and specifics on which skills/tools are exposed over MCP.
